subject: TYPE clause
notes: kb/Work PB205. All three of SR10's sentences: the TYPE CH/CF operand may be qualified and reference-modified (the capture keeps both), its ref-mod positions shall be integer literals (screened at the capture with the clause's own citation), and it 'shall be the same as one of the operands of the CONTROL clause' - one comparison over the whole written reference, shared with 13.18.54.3 SR8. Before this the operand kept only its base word and matched by name, so CX(4:3) selected the CX(1:3) level and the minor footing printed at the major level.
